description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50% (25s)] to all enemies, grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] and [Quick Cast 3] to all allies, grants [Dual Awoken Frog-Catcher Mode I (Quina)] to the user, grants [IX Resonance +3% Boost] to all FFIX allies

description.name: Dual Awoken Frog-Catcher Mode I (Quina)
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Support abilities, casts Dual Frog Guard after using Support abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Frog-Catcher Mode II (Quina)] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Frog-Catcher Mode II (Quina)
description.text: Instant cast speed for Support abilities, casts Dual Legendary Frog after using a support ability

description.name: Dual Legendary Frog
description.text: Grants [Weakness +9% Boost 2]/[Weakness +50% Boost 2] to all allies if 0-3/4+ FFIX allies are alive, [Quick Cast 2] to all allies

description.name: Weakness +9% Boost 2
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 9% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +50% Boost 2
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 50% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Dual Frog Guard
description.text: Grants [20% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] and [HP Stock (1000)] to all allies

description.name: ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50% (25s)
description.text: ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50%

description.name: IX Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 3% if the character's Realm is IX
